title: fix(spec, runtime)!: composeStacks admits two namespaces' object-less action of one name under manifest 'preserve', and the boot binds each package's actions under its package (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB63xj6Gw82oLdXn2eJrNWKd)_

Fixes #32245

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `ObjectQL.executeAction(object, name, ctx, { packageId })` qualified by a multi-package artifact's OWN id (the artifact's top-level manifest, the last input's under `composeStacks(…, { manifest: 'preserve' })`) no longer reaches an action another package of that artifact declares alone: FROM running it TO `Action 'NAME' on object 'OBJECT' not found`, because each such action is now registered under its declaring package (`app:PACKAGE_ID`), not the artifact's (`app:ARTIFACT_ID`). Two more engine calls move with it: `listRegisteredActions({ packageId: ARTIFACT_ID })` FROM listing every body's action keys TO listing the artifact's own package's (and shared handlers'); and `removeActionsByPackage('app:ARTIFACT_ID')` FROM removing every action the artifact bound TO leaving each other body's handlers registered and runnable under `app:PACKAGE_ID`. The REST door `POST /actions/NS/OBJECT/NAME` is not moved by it: it resolves the namespace's declarations first and answered `404` for another package's action before too. Measured first-party: 0 (the one first-party composition, `examples/app-multi-package`, declares no action; no first-party code qualifies a call by a composed artifact's id). The fix: qualify by the declaring package's id (`packageId`) or namespace (`/actions/NS/…`); to unbind the artifact, remove each `app:PACKAGE_ID` its bodies name as well, or re-bind it (`bindAppArtifactHandlers` tears down every owner its previous bind registered). It also widens: `composeStacks([a, b], { manifest: 'preserve' })` no longer refuses `STACK_COMPOSE_ACTION_KEY_COLLISION` when two packages of two different namespaces each declare one object-less action of a name: each body stays under its own package, as installing the two one by one already admits; and a package-qualified call (`POST /actions/NS/global/NAME`, `executeAction` with `packageId`) reaches the actions of a package other than the artifact's own id: measured on an object-less action, it answered `404` before.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `content/docs/` and no skill under `skills/` teaches a call qualified by a composed artifact's own id, or a multi-package artifact's actions at all (the composition section of `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx` names `manifest: 'preserve'` and says nothing about actions of one name across packages or their addresses).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`composeStacks` 在 `manifest: 'preserve'` 下，允许两个不同命名空间的包各自声明同名的无对象动作（与逐个安装的规则一致）；多包产物启动时，每个包的动作处理器登记在该包名下，而不再全部登记在产物自己的 id 下。
- 为什么改：#31697 落地后安装已放行这对动作，而合成仍拒绝，一个产物装不下两次安装能装下的东西；同时测得启动会把多包产物的动作全部压到产物 id 下，`/actions/alpha/global/NAME` 在基线上直接 404。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（BREAKING）：进程内 `executeAction` 用多包产物自身 id 作 `packageId` 调另一个包独有的动作，以前能跑，现在报找不到，应改用声明它的包 id 或命名空间（REST 入口前后都是 404，不受影响）；同时放宽，首方计数均为 0；默认（扁平）manifest、同一命名空间、同一包两份、无命名空间的包、绑定对象的动作仍按原样拒绝。多包产物里只由一个包声明的动作，其处理器归属从产物 id 改为该包 id；两个包共有的键仍是产物 id 下的一个处理器（两命名空间的无对象动作对除外），被合成替换掉的声明不绑定。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 `composedPackagesHoldApart` 与 `collectComposedActionKeyCollisions`；`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts` 的 `actionBindingGroups`；`packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts` 的 `namespacedHoldersMeet`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/composed-object-less-action-pair.test.ts`，应 11/11 通过（两种内核形态各自：两个命名空间地址各跑自己的动作体、裸调用 409 点名两个包、按产物自身 id 限定的调用不再跑到别的包的动作）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Compose (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, step 6).** `collectComposedActionKeyCollisions` takes `preserve`. A key declared by two or more input stacks is admitted when it is the object-less key (no object embeds it), the composition is `manifest: 'preserve'`, and `composedPackagesHoldApart` holds: each stack is ONE package (a `manifest` with an `id`, and no `packages` list of its own, since a nested artifact's top-level actions belong to no single body), no two stacks are one package, and no two meet under `namespacedHoldersMeet`. Under the default (flattening) manifest the same pair is refused as before, and the refusal gains one sentence naming `{ manifest: 'preserve' }` as the way to keep both; the sentence is added only when `preserve` would admit a refused key. Two packages of one namespace, two bodies of one package, a package with no namespace and every object-bound key are refused under either manifest, with today's text.

**One rule, one place (ruling item 1).** The install gate's predicate is `bareNameHoldersMeet` in `@objectstack/objectql` (`bare-name-one-holder.ts`), which spec cannot import. Its namespace half moved down to spec as `namespacedHoldersMeet(incoming, holder)` in `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts` (the module that already holds the namespace rules shared by compile time and runtime), and `bareNameHoldersMeet` now calls it for a type narrowed to the namespace. Which types narrowed (`NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`) stays in objectql; compose applies the rule to the object-less action only, the narrowed type it composes. No accepted shape changes; one new export (`api-surface/kernel.json`, `export-origins/kernel.json` regenerated).

**Boot (ruling item 3, in scope: the boot re-flattened actions).** `bindAppArtifactHandlers` read a multi-package artifact's actions through `resolveArtifactCollections`, which keys an item by its name, so the second body's same-named action was dropped; and it registered every action under the artifact's owner (`app:ARTIFACT_ID`, the last input's manifest). Measured on base (the pair hand-built into the artifact, since base compose refuses it): `POST /actions/alpha/global/qa_send_note` → `404 "Action 'qa_send_note' on object 'global' not found"`, and alpha's one-holder action at `/actions/alpha/global/qa_solo_note` → `404` too, on both kernel shapes. Now `actionBindingGroups` binds, for a bundle carrying `packages[]`, exactly what the reconciled artifact carries (`collectBundleActions(bundle)`, base's read, so a declaration an `objectConflict: 'override'` composition replaced is bound at no address), and owns each declaration by the bodies that carry its key (`OBJECT:NAME`), read in `resolveArtifactPackageOrder`'s order: one body, under that body's `app:PACKAGE_ID`; no body (a top-level residual), under the artifact's owner; two or more bodies, ONE handler from the reconciled declaration under the artifact's owner, as base bound it, except the object-less key whose bodies no two of which meet under `namespacedHoldersMeet` (the pair compose admits), where each body binds its own declaration under its own package. A bundle with no `packages[]` binds exactly as before. The teardown removes the artifact's owner, every owner the new groups name, and every owner the artifact's previous bind on that engine registered, so a package body a re-bind drops stops running (base removed it with the one owner). Both doors bind through this function: `AppPlugin` and the install-local door (`MarketplaceInstallLocal`, install and rehydrate). Hooks and functions stay under the artifact's owner (see Acceptance notes).

## Why

#32213 (#31697) let two packages of two namespaces each hold one object-less action name at install, while `composeStacks` kept the one-holder rule, so one artifact could not carry a pair two installs carry (card #32245, ADR-0150 D4).

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/compose-stacks-action-key-collision.test.ts`, new describe "two packages' object-less action of one name, held per namespace" (9 cases): two namespaces compose under `preserve`, each body under its own package, no flattened copy; three namespaces compose; CONTROL one namespace refused `STACK_COMPOSE_ACTION_KEY_COLLISION` naming both, no `preserve` sentence; the default manifest (`undefined`, `'first'`, `'last'`, `0`) refused with the full message plus the new sentence; the sentence is absent when a refused key beside the pair is one `preserve` refuses too, and present for three namespaces; two bodies of one package refused; a package with no namespace refused (no sentence); a third package of a present namespace refused; an object-bound key across two namespaces refused.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.test.ts`: `namespacedHoldersMeet` truth table.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/composed-object-less-action-pair.test.ts` (new): composes the pair with `composeStacks`, writes the artifact, boots it the way `createStandaloneStack` composes it (artifact door + `AppPlugin`) on both kernel shapes, and drives the real `HttpDispatcher`: each namespace's address runs its own body; the bare call is `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both packages and nothing runs; CONTROL a one-holder action runs on the bare door; that action also runs on its own package's address; NARROWING `executeAction` with `packageId` = the artifact's own id (beta's) answers `Action 'qa_solo_note' on object 'global' not found` for alpha's action, where base ran it, and the REST address `POST /actions/beta/global/qa_solo_note` answers `404` as on base.
- `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.test.ts`, new describe "bindAppArtifactHandlers on a multi-package artifact" (4 cases, a real `ObjectQL` and the real sandbox): a `preserve` artifact composed with `objectConflict: 'override'` binds the object's embedded action once, under the artifact's owner, running the reconciled body, and the replaced body at no package coordinate; the same under `'merge'` with identical declarations; a hand-built artifact whose two bodies of ONE namespace carry one object-less key binds it once, under the artifact's owner; a re-bind that drops a package body stops that body's action.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; every restore printed blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):

| # | Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `if (preserve) continue;` → `if (preserve && false) continue;` (widening off) | spec file: 2 red (two namespaces, three namespaces), 31 green |
| A2 | delete the `namespacedHoldersMeet` line in `composedPackagesHoldApart` | spec file: 5 red (one-namespace CONTROL, no-namespace, third package, and the two existing no-namespace pins), 28 green |
| A3 | `actionBindingGroups` always one group under the artifact owner (round 1) | runtime pin: 4 red (both qualified-address cases, both shapes), 5 green (bare 409, CONTROL, compose case) |
| A4 | `app-artifact-handlers.ts` swapped for round 1's (`8c9a7da4`, each body read alone) | binder describe: 4 red (override and merge: `ActionHandlerAmbiguityError` on the call that names no package; hand-built: the same; re-bind: the dropped body's action still listed), 18 green |
| A5 | `holders.length > 1 && heldApart(key, holders)` → `holders.length > 1` (every shared key split per package) | 3 red (override, merge, hand-built), 19 green |
| A6 | `holders.length > 1 && heldApart(key, holders)` → `holders.length > 1 && false` (no shared key split) | 2 red (each namespace's address runs its own body, both shapes), 20 green |
| A7 | `preserveWouldAdmit: admissible > 0 && inadmissible === 0` → `admissible > 0` | spec file: 1 red (the mixed refusal names `preserve`), 33 green |
| A8 | `actionBindingGroups` returns one group under the artifact owner for every bundle (base's binding) | runtime pin: 6 red (both qualified-address cases and the NARROWING case, both shapes; under it `executeAction` with `packageId` = the artifact's id ran `{ from: 'alpha-solo' }`), 5 green |

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise** (main `351c22c9`): `composeStacks([alpha, beta], { manifest: 'preserve' })` and the default manifest both threw `StackComposeActionKeyCollisionError` (`STACK_COMPOSE_ACTION_KEY_COLLISION`). Installing alpha at boot and then beta (`manifest.register(beta, { source: 'marketplace' })`, after the seal) on a kernel of this tree: installed, as #32213's install gate rules. Census: one first-party composition (`examples/app-multi-package/objectstack.config.ts`), which declares no action; no template composes stacks. Count 0.
- **Reconciled objects (review F1).** A `preserve` artifact composed with `objectConflict: 'override'` or `'merge'` over one object two packages declare does not boot: `registerApp` refuses `ArtifactObjectNameConflictError` (ADR-0130 D3, "sharing an object NAME is not" allowed across packages of one artifact), measured on both kernel shapes at this head; that registration is not touched by this diff. Round 1's binder, called directly on such a bundle, bound the key under both package coordinates (A4); this head binds it once, from the reconciled declaration, under the artifact's owner, as base did.
- **The bare 409's text** names both packages (`package "com.qa.compose.alpha"; package "com.qa.compose.beta". … address it by its package.`), the #32213 sentence; it does not spell the `/actions/NS/global/NAME` URLs.
- **Not fixed, reported (ruling item 5):** hooks and functions of a multi-package artifact are still bound under the artifact's owner, not their package (NOT MEASURED: what that changes for a disabled package's hook). `resolveArtifactCollections` keys every collection item by `name`, so two bodies' same-named items of any other family resolve to one for every reader of it; the binder was the only reader of `collectBundleActions`. Compose step 6 reads each input's top-level `actions` only, so a nested multi-package artifact used as an input has its bodies' actions unwalked (NOT MEASURED). Other compose collision families were not examined.
